title: Broken after first usage!
text: Broken after first usage!. I thought this was a great set at first. I used the largest one to make cupcakes and the smallest to whisk eggs, and they worked just fine.They also were easy to clean. When I used the medium one, however, it broke when I was making cornbread. It wasn't that thick of a batter and shouldnt have broken by a little bit of mixing. Disappointed, wish they would be built sturdier!
